evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/voting/pages/VoteCreatePage.tsx:147 — handleSubmit() runs a non-transactional multi-step sequence under one try/catch: createVote.mutateAsync() (line 148) -> per-question loop of addQuestion(vote.id, ...) (line 168) -> optional publishVote(vote.id) (line 172).

If any addQuestion or publishVote call fails mid-sequence (network/validation), the already-created vote persists server-side with only a partial set of questions; the client shows a generic 'Failed to create vote' toast (lines 182-186) and resets submitting. The user retries and creates a second (duplicate) vote, leaving the first as an orphaned/partial draft.

Fix direction: create the vote with its questions in a single batched API call; OR roll back by deleting the created vote.id on failure of a later step; OR make the handler resumable (detect an already-created vote.id on retry and continue adding questions instead of re-creating).

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/registry/pages/RegistryPage.tsx:91 — all six in-app navigation handlers assign to window.location.href for SPA routes: handlePetView (91), handlePetEdit (95), handlePetCreate (129), handleVehicleView (148), handleVehicleEdit (152), and the vehicle create handler.

This is a react-router-dom SPA (useNavigate is used in 31 other files). window.location.href triggers a full document reload on every view/edit/create click, discarding in-memory React/TanStack Query state and forcing a full app re-bootstrap + re-auth/re-fetch — a noticeable UX regression on an authenticated dashboard. Reachable on any row action (handlers wired directly to buttons).

Fix direction: replace the window.location.href assignments with useNavigate()/navigate(path) as the rest of the app does. (compliance/ContentModerationPage.tsx:207 has the same pattern but carries an explicit TODO(Phase-2) acknowledgement; RegistryPage does not.)
